entries.0e2f1b9ba575fcf1: This is a compound that improves the balance between efficacy and safety of 5-FU anticancer drugs. Targeting gastrointestinal cancers such as pancreatic cancer, in January 2026 it started an investigator-initiated clinical trial (Phase 1/2 clinical trial) for biliary tract cancer in Japan, in collaboration with the General Incorporated Association Japan Hepato-Biliary-Pancreatic Oncology Network. No licensee has been determined yet.

entries.25ed27d32d807fc9: This is a development candidate that suppresses proliferation by alkalinizing the environment around cancer cells (the tumor microenvironment).

entries.2cc2ce6ac77004d2: DFP-10917 (relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia)
entries.2e622d8fd47877da: This is a development candidate that suppresses proliferation by alkalinizing the environment around cancer cells (the tumor microenvironment). Targeting solid tumors such as pancreatic cancer, it is advancing a Phase 2/3 clinical trial in Japan. It has granted an exclusive license for Japan to Nippon Chemiphar.
entries.3f8cd4c0f152899b: This is a nucleic acid drug using RNA interference, and a development candidate aimed at effects on peritoneal carcinomatosis through intraperitoneal administration. Targeting peritoneal carcinomatosis of gastric cancer and ovarian cancer, it is preparing to start a Phase 1 clinical trial. No licensee has been determined yet.
entries.410cd630a5d15f9a: This is a single segment consisting only of the pharmaceutical business. This business creates anticancer drug candidate compounds through 'module drug discovery', which combines active substances of existing anticancer drugs as 'modules' to create new anticancer drugs. It conducts preclinical and clinical trials in-house and grants development and sales rights to pharmaceutical companies under license. In the fiscal year ended March 2026 there were no milestone income or other receipts, and business revenue was nil. Amounts are not disclosed for each development candidate.
entries.451fea1a2fa9f420: Pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas (exploring licensees)
entries.5953fd881e7bc161: This is a development candidate aimed at expanding the indications of the approved drug ubenimex, and it has an effect of enhancing the immune function of cancer patients. It is progressing case enrollment for a Phase 3 clinical trial in Japan, targeting patients with terminal or elderly lung cancer, etc. It has granted an exclusive license for Japan to Nippon Chemiphar.
entries.821e59f79fc0185a: A company that develops anticancer drug candidate compounds through "module drug discovery," which creates new anticancer drugs by combining the active substances of existing anticancer drugs.
entries.8bbeedbe5bdb7315: This is an anticancer drug candidate compound targeting relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia. By continuous infusion at a low dose over a long period, it self-cleaves DNA strands and induces cancer cell death. Its Phase 3 clinical trial in the United States was discontinued following a recommendation from the independent safety committee (DSMB), while a Phase 1/2 clinical trial of combination therapy with venetoclax is progressing in the United States, and in Japan Nippon Shinyaku is conducting a Phase 1 clinical trial.

entries.cc6d813b72efee32: This is a compound that improves the balance between efficacy and safety of 5-FU anticancer drugs.
entries.e07b689eb8cac396: This is a development candidate in which a polymer (4-arm-PEG) is bound to DFP-10917 to deliver it selectively to cancer tissue.
entries.f42122c7e503d797: This is a development candidate in which a polymer (4-arm-PEG) is bound to DFP-10917 to deliver it selectively to cancer tissue. Targeting solid tumors such as pancreatic cancer, it is conducting an expansion study of a Phase 1 clinical trial in the United States. It has entered into a joint development agreement with Sanyo Chemical Industries.
